name: @tysel/runtime-js
description: JavaScript bootstrap, Web API shims, capability client, and durable helpers loaded into isolates.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-runtime.mjs --check && node --check web-api/source/*.js && node --check capability-client/source/*.js && node --check web-api/runtime.js && node --check capability-client/runtime.js && node --check durable/runtime.js && node --check durable/control.js && node --check bootstrap/*.js
